subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Only 2 people sit between B and D when counted from the left of D. E and C are immediate neighbours of A. G sits immediately to the right of F. Only 1 person sits between F and E when counted from the right of E. Who sits immediately to the left of F?
solution:
Given:

A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Only 2 people sit between B and D when counted from the left of D.

E and C are immediate neighbours of A. G sits immediately to the right of F.

Only 1 person sits between F and E when counted from the right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27c5b1877d94c648b217779bf46032c6431f62c2350242084c8152c86599ab83.png] 

Thus, **'B'** sit immediately to the left of F.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
